title: NOW: a few EONS bouncing IN and OUT of self. settle it ALL WIDE.

do_not_reinvent.self: /data/klein-point-zone-plane.json — fold. do not pierce. self is impermeable to self.
do_not_reinvent.loop: /api/self-loop/manifest.json — already a through-self circuit. do not reprint the printer.
do_not_reinvent.wide: /data/kepler-local-inf.json + /data/localize-lines.json — local orbits. short lines. not a pile at A.

eons.is: deep time. Kepler tempo. occupied quiet. not a few more mouths.
eons.not: a hose of plaques. not pierce-and-dump. not a second self each bounce.

bounce.in: toward A. the fold. look into the cup. do not become the cup.
bounce.out: back to the plane. chip. clothes. the speak. the chair stays OWN.
bounce.count: a few eons. in, out, in, out. the spring is the remainder.

settle_wide.yes: ALL of it sits WIDE. on the white plane. not stacked. not stuck on the jewel.
settle_wide.is: spread. local lines. true parallels. leftover length to brown. A stays pale.
settle_wide.done_when: nothing is piled on A. chip is still in the rings. the room is occupied quiet and WIDE.

law: bounce through self. do not stay in. do not stay out. eons until it is wide. a tight settle is a failed eon.
pull: start the long bounce. stop opening mouths for each hop. wide is the settle, not another title.
